programs.name: Bachelor of Computer Science (C2001)
programs.a_level_offer: Entry score 9 for 2027 intake: the best 3 A Levels scored A*/A = 5, B = 4, C = 3, D = 2, E = 1 and summed (a maximum of 1 bonus point for an A*).
programs.ib_offer: 28 points (2027 intake entry score). Prerequisites: English SL 4 (HL 3) in English A: Literature, English A: Language and Literature, Literature and Performance, Literary Arts, English AB or English B (HL: English A: Literature, Language and Literature or English B); Mathematics: Analysis and Approaches SL 4, or HL 3 in Analysis and Approaches or Applications and Interpretations.
programs.ap_offer: Advanced Placement: entry score 7 for 2027 intake, the total of the best 2 AP exams (minimum 3 in each). Alternatively SAT 1190 (Evidence-Based Reading and Writing plus Math, out of 1600) or ACT 24 (average of the best three section scores from Math, English and Reading). An official final transcript and evidence of completing a Monash-approved senior secondary qualification are also required.
programs.toefl_note: Old 0-120 scale: TOEFL iBT 79 overall (reading 13, listening 12, speaking 18, writing 21). New 1-6 scale: 4 overall (reading 3.5, listening 3, speaking 3.5, writing 4.5).
programs.english_note: Monash English Level A. Also accepted: PTE Academic 58 (no communicative skill below 50).
programs.notes: 2027 intake entry scores from the course page's international view; the ATAR of 80 is the Australian Year 12 score. Fee is the 2027 international fee for 48 credit points (a standard full-time year). Starts in February or July; Monash says international students (not applying from Year 12) can apply any time of year and publishes no closing date, so apply early (https://www.monash.edu/admissions/apply/international-ug). Offered at Clayton and Malaysia; specialisations (Clayton) are Algorithms and Software, Artificial Intelligence, Cybersecurity and Data Science. The VCE prerequisites were not extracted. For qualifications other than IB or Australian Year 12, Monash assumes the equivalent maths knowledge if you completed maths at the required level (no AP course is named), so confirm with Monash.
